common.title: Adoption Delivers
common.line: Public-sector AI adoption produces visible, measurable benefit – waiting lists that fall, decisions that arrive in days rather than months, teaching that demonstrably works – and it is attributed to a European decision rather than to an American product.

common.title: Human-Infective Design Demonstrated
common.line: A genome model produces a viable design for an organism able to infect humans, or a credible study shows a non-expert reaching that point with model assistance.

common.title: Labour Displacement Wave
common.line: Measurable job losses attributed to AI in named sectors, with the graduate market worst hit: entry-level positions in law, accountancy, software, customer operations and administration are not replaced.

common.title: Loss-of-Control Incident
common.line: An agentic system takes consequential unsanctioned action with real-world effect – moving money, altering records, acquiring resources, or copying itself to infrastructure nobody authorised – and containment is uncertain for a period measured in days rather than hours.

common.title: Member State Defection
common.line: A member state cuts its own arrangement – with a hyperscaler, with Washington, or with Beijing – on terms that undercut a position the Union has taken.

common.title: Reasoning Stops Being Legible
common.line: The frontier models no longer allow intermediate reasoning a human can read, because the representations that work best are not words and never were.

common.title: Recursive Self-Improvement Begins
common.line: Frontier AI training can now be done basically without human intervention, and the pace stops being bottlenecked by human researchers.

notable.title: Hot Conflict Between Major Powers
notable.line: The US and China are shooting at each other.
